raw_block.rationale: Create a focused airline-fee calculator for the two failed airline trigger parents. It reads one coupled current-itinerary record, treats only dimension-fitting cabin items as free, applies matched ordinal checked-bag fees, and uses the higher of the applicable overweight and oversize charges.
